mapper.select: SELECT CUBE_ID, NAME, SOURCE_FACT, KIND, KEY_FIELD, LATENESS_MS, SCHEMA_VERSION FROM ANALYTICS_DATASET WHERE CUBE_ID = #{cubeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ANALYTICS_DATASET (CUBE_ID, NAME, SOURCE_FACT, KIND, KEY_FIELD, LATENESS_MS, SCHEMA_VERSION) VALUES (#{cubeId}, #{name}, #{sourceFact}, #{kind}, #{keyField}, #{latenessMs}, #{schemaVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT CUBE_ID, ORDINAL, FIELD, OPERATOR, FILTER_VALUE FROM ANALYTICS_DATASET_FILTER ORDER BY CUBE_ID, ORDINAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ANALYTICS_DATASET_FILTER (CUBE_ID, ORDINAL, FIELD, OPERATOR, FILTER_VALUE) VALUES (#{cubeId}, #{ordinal}, #{field}, #{operator}, #{filterValue})
mapper.select: SELECT CUBE_ID, ORDINAL, NAME, DIM_TYPE, ENRICHMENT FROM ANALYTICS_DATASET_DIMENSION ORDER BY CUBE_ID, ORDINAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ANALYTICS_DATASET_DIMENSION (CUBE_ID, ORDINAL, NAME, DIM_TYPE, ENRICHMENT) VALUES (#{cubeId}, #{ordinal}, #{name}, #{dimType}, #{enrichment})
mapper.select: SELECT CUBE_ID, ORDINAL, NAME, METER_TYPE, MEASURE_FIELD FROM ANALYTICS_DATASET_METER ORDER BY CUBE_ID, ORDINAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ANALYTICS_DATASET_METER (CUBE_ID, ORDINAL, NAME, METER_TYPE, MEASURE_FIELD) VALUES (#{cubeId}, #{ordinal}, #{name}, #{meterType}, #{measureField})
mapper.select: SELECT CUBE_ID, METER_ORDINAL, PARAM_KEY, PARAM_VALUE FROM ANALYTICS_DATASET_METER_PARAM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ANALYTICS_DATASET_METER_PARAM (CUBE_ID, METER_ORDINAL, PARAM_KEY, PARAM_VALUE) VALUES (#{cubeId}, #{meterOrdinal}, #{paramKey}, #{paramValue})
mapper.select: SELECT CUBE_ID, ORDINAL, WINDOW_MS FROM ANALYTICS_DATASET_WINDOW ORDER BY CUBE_ID, ORDINAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ANALYTICS_DATASET_WINDOW (CUBE_ID, ORDINAL, WINDOW_MS) VALUES (#{cubeId}, #{ordinal}, #{windowMs})
mapper.select: SELECT CUBE_ID, PARTITION_ID, ACTIVATION_POSITION FROM ANALYTICS_DATASET_ACTIVATION
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ANALYTICS_DATASET_ACTIVATION (CUBE_ID, PARTITION_ID, ACTIVATION_POSITION) VALUES (#{cubeId}, #{partitionId}, #{activationPosition})
